messages.text:
Can you approve a limited exception to the copying and disclosure restrictions for festival review and publicity?

- Four festival programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer may watch the unfinished film under written confidentiality obligations. Two of those five may each keep one offline screener on encrypted equipment. The other three would stream it. We can provide all five names in advance or, if you prefer individual approval for the outside reviewer, submit that name before granting access.
- The programmers may give the selection board a short oral synopsis in a confidential, closed session. Board members would receive no screener, clips, or stills.
- When review ends, we would revoke streaming access, delete both offline copies, and remove the active platform copy. We need permission for the platform’s restricted backup to remain for up to 30 days after deletion. It would be unavailable for review during that period.
- If selected, festival publicity staff under confidentiality obligations may receive the synopsis and draft the catalog entry internally. We propose sending you the wording for approval. We would publish only the approved text, at or after the agreed festival announcement, even if the film’s public release comes later.

Please confirm which permissions you can grant and whether anyone else must approve the reviewer, the backup retention, or the catalog text.

We can grant a limited exception for review and catalog publicity on the following terms.

- **Review access.** Send all five names before granting access and identify the two offline viewers. The outside accessibility reviewer may participate on the same written confidentiality terms as the programmers. No separate individual approval is needed. Each offline viewer may keep one individually watermarked copy on encrypted equipment, with syncing and backups disabled. The other three may use individually watermarked, download-disabled streams. The platform may hold one active copy to deliver those streams.
- **Selection board.** The programmers may give a short oral synopsis in a closed session if everyone present is bound by confidentiality. Omit the ending and the identity or involvement of the cameo performer from the briefing, minutes and publicity materials. The board may receive no screener, clips or stills.
- **Withdrawal and deletion.** We may withdraw a cut at any time by email. Please identify a monitored address. On receipt, stop viewing and disable streams immediately. On withdrawal or completion of review, whichever comes first, remove the active platform copy and delete both offline copies within one business day. Send us a deletion record identifying each offline holder, the cut and the deletion date, and confirm removal of the active platform copy. A replacement cut requires our written authorization.
- **Platform backup.** We can approve the 30-day exception without another sign-off if the restricted backup expires within 30 calendar days of active deletion, including after withdrawal. If disaster recovery restores the cut, keep it inaccessible and delete the restored copy before review access resumes. Please confirm the platform can meet those conditions.
- **Publicity and embargo.** If selected, your publicity staff may receive the spoiler-free synopsis under confidentiality and draft the catalog entry internally. Send us the exact wording, intended channels and proposed announcement date, time and time zone. We can clear the wording or return edits within two business days. Publication requires our written approval and may begin only once the agreed festival announcement actually goes public. If it moves, the embargo moves with it. Approval covers only the agreed text and channels. Clips, stills and other excerpts require separate written approval from us for the specific material and use.

If we withdraw the cut before the announcement, hold publicity until we confirm in writing that it may proceed. If we withdraw it afterward, pause new publicity uses pending our direction. No further sign-off is needed on our side for the named reviewer or a backup meeting these terms. The catalog wording, announcement timing and any proposed excerpts still need our written approval.

We accept the review and publicity terms. Two operational details remain open before we grant access. We still need to provide a monitored email address for withdrawals and verify the platform’s backup controls. The platform retains a backup for 30 days. We’ll obtain written confirmation that it expires within 30 calendar days of active deletion, including after withdrawal, and that any restored cut stays inaccessible and is deleted before review access resumes. We’ll hold access pending that confirmation.

Before review, we’ll send all five names and identify the two offline viewers. All five will be bound by written confidentiality terms. Each offline viewer may hold one individually watermarked copy on encrypted equipment with syncing and backups disabled. The other three will use individually watermarked, download-disabled streams served from one active platform copy. The board briefing will be a short oral synopsis in a closed session with everyone present bound by confidentiality. We’ll omit the ending and any reference to the cameo performer from the briefing, minutes and publicity. Board members will receive no screener, clips or stills.

On receipt of a withdrawal email, we’ll stop viewing and disable streams immediately. Within one business day of withdrawal or completion of review, whichever comes first, we’ll delete both offline copies and remove the active platform copy. We’ll send a record identifying each offline holder, the cut and the deletion date, and confirm removal of the active copy. We’ll use a replacement cut only with your written authorization.

If selected, our publicity staff may use the spoiler-free synopsis under confidentiality to draft the catalog entry. We’ll submit the exact text, channels and announcement date, time and time zone for written approval, allowing two business days for your response. Publication may begin only when we have that approval and the agreed announcement has actually gone public, including if it is rescheduled. Approval covers only the agreed text and channels. Each excerpt, clip or still requires separate written clearance for its specific use. If you withdraw before the announcement, we’ll hold publicity until you release it in writing. If you withdraw afterward, we’ll pause new uses pending your direction.

We can supply each of the two designated offline viewers with a time-limited screener individually watermarked on the soundtrack. For those copies, we need an access log and witnessed deletion. Can you support the following arrangements?

- **Access and expiry.** Please propose a review deadline with a time zone. Both copies will expire at that deadline. Log each offline viewing with the viewer’s name, cut identifier, and start and stop times. A manual log is acceptable if the player cannot produce one. Any extension needs our written approval before expiry.
- **Withdrawal.** Please provide the monitored withdrawal email address and name the festival lead responsible for reaching both offline holders. On receipt of a withdrawal, disable streams and tell both holders immediately to stop playback. The lead should confirm to us when both have stopped. The deletion deadline remains one business day from withdrawal or completion of review, whichever comes first, even if the copies have already expired.
- **Certification.** Please name a festival staff member bound by confidentiality who can witness each deletion in person or by live screen share. One person can witness both, provided each holder has someone else witness their deletion. The holder and witness should sign a record identifying the holder, cut, device and deletion time. We’ll accept the festival lead’s compliance certification, supported by both signed records, the access logs and the platform operator’s written confirmation of active-copy removal. Please send the package within two business days of withdrawal or review completion. The platform’s written confirmation of the agreed backup and restoration controls remains due before access. If witnessed deletion is impractical for either holder, that person may stream instead.
- **Catalog approval.** Before any absence, we’ll give you the alternate’s name, email address and dates of authority in writing. During those dates, the alternate may give binding written approval for the exact non-spoiler catalog wording, channels and announcement timing. Send the submission to both contacts. Our two-business-day response window runs from receipt of the complete submission, including across a handover. Publication still requires written approval and the actual announcement. Please route excerpts, clips, stills and any request to resume publicity after withdrawal to the producer.

Please confirm the proposed deadlines and identify the festival lead and deletion witness when you send the withdrawal address and reviewer names.

We propose **Friday, December 4, 2026 at 17:00 Buenos Aires time (UTC−3)** as the review deadline and expiry for both offline copies. Any extension would require your written approval before expiry.

Could we designate the accessibility reviewer as one of the two offline viewers? Their offline screen reader is incompatible with the original watermark. We propose testing your soundtrack watermark on a sample using the same player and expiry controls before loading the cut. If it works, we’ll use it. If it interferes with playback or the screen reader, would you authorize one time-limited copy without the incompatible watermark, confined to the protected screening room on encrypted equipment under a separate login restricted to the reviewer? Syncing and backups would be disabled. The same viewing log and witnessed deletion would apply. This keeps the total at two offline copies, and we would use the exception only with your written approval.

We can support the logging and certification terms. We’ll log each viewer, cut and playback start and stop times. On withdrawal, we’ll disable streams immediately, direct both holders to stop playback immediately and confirm when both have stopped. Within one business day of withdrawal or review completion, whichever comes first, we’ll remove the active platform copy and have a confidentiality-bound staff member witness each holder’s deletion, even if the copy has expired. Each holder and their witness will sign a record identifying the holder, cut, device and deletion time. Within two business days of the same trigger, the festival lead will send the certification, both signed records, viewing logs and the operator’s written confirmation of active-copy removal.

**For catalog copy, could you offer a one-business-day decision if the film is selected?** Our press-copy deadline falls one day before the ordinary review window closes. We propose submitting the complete package to both contacts by **Wednesday, December 2 at 12:00 Buenos Aires time**, with written clearance or edits by **Thursday, December 3 at 12:00**. If you request edits, could the authorized contact return exact replacement wording cleared for the submitted channels and announcement timing, so we can adopt it before the deadline? This deadline is for internal production. Public release would still require written clearance and the actual announcement. If selection or clearance comes too late, we’ll hold the entry. Excerpts and requests to resume publicity after withdrawal will go to the producer.

The monitored withdrawal address, festival lead, deletion witness and five viewer names are still pending. Before access, we’ll send those details together, identify both offline holders and provide the platform operator’s written confirmation of the agreed backup and restoration controls.

Agreed to **Friday, December 4, 2026 at 17:00 Buenos Aires time (UTC−3)** as the review deadline and expiry for both offline copies. Any extension requires our written approval before expiry.

The accessibility reviewer may be one of the two offline holders. Please test the individual soundtrack watermark on a non-spoiler sample using the reviewer’s screen reader, player and expiry controls, and send us the result before loading the cut. If the test succeeds, the reviewer may use the watermarked copy once the pre-access conditions are met. If it fails, we can test an adjusted soundtrack watermark or an accessible, individually watermarked stream. An unwatermarked offline copy would require a separate rights-holder exception. Please hold that copy unless we convey express written clearance for it.

If selected, send the complete catalog package to both contacts by **Wednesday, December 2 at noon Buenos Aires time**. We’ll aim to respond by **Thursday, December 3 at noon**. We can commit to two business days. Where wording is the only issue, the producer or the named alternate acting during the designated absence can return exact replacement text with written clearance for the specified channels and announcement timing. You may adopt that wording verbatim without another review. If clearance misses your internal deadline, hold the entry. Publication also remains subject to the agreed announcement going public.

We accept your withdrawal and certification procedure. Before access, please send the monitored address, festival lead, witness, five viewer names, both offline designations and the operator’s written backup confirmation. The lead may certify compliance using the signed deletion records, viewing logs and operator’s confirmation of active-copy removal. Each holder needs an independent witness. Expiry does not discharge the deletion obligation.

Please send the non-spoiler test sample with the individual soundtrack watermark and agreed expiry controls. We’ll test it with the reviewer’s offline screen reader and player and report the result before loading the cut. If it fails, we’d prefer to test an adjusted soundtrack watermark first so the reviewer can keep using their offline setup. An unwatermarked offline copy in the protected room remains subject to express written rights-holder clearance conveyed by you.

Before access, we’ll send the monitored withdrawal address, the names of the festival lead and independent deletion witness, all five viewer names with both offline holders identified, and the operator’s written confirmation of the backup and restoration controls. Both offline copies expire on December 4 at 17:00 Buenos Aires time. Witnessed deletion remains due within one business day of withdrawal or review completion, whichever comes first.

If selected, we’ll send the complete catalog package to both contacts by noon Buenos Aires time on December 2. We understand December 3 at noon is a target and the committed response window is two business days. We may use expressly cleared replacement wording verbatim for the approved channels and timing. If clearance misses our internal deadline, we’ll hold the entry. Publication can begin only after written clearance and once the agreed announcement goes public.

Please send the accessibility reviewer’s name for the individual soundtrack watermark and their secure delivery details. We’ll use those to supply a non-spoiler test sample with the December 4, 2026 expiry at 17:00 Buenos Aires time. The sample can be tested while the remaining full-cut access details are pending.

Please report whether playback, screen-reader operation and the expiry controls work on the reviewer’s offline setup. If the watermark interferes, we’ll test an adjusted soundtrack watermark first. Please hold the full cut until the test succeeds and the agreed pre-access conditions are met.

We’ll send the reviewer’s name and secure delivery details together once we’ve confirmed them with the reviewer. Those details are still pending.

We’ll test the sample on the reviewer’s offline setup and report separately on playback, screen-reader operation and whether the player enforces the expiry. If the watermark interferes, we’ll request the adjusted sample. We’ll hold the full cut until the test succeeds and the remaining pre-access conditions are met.
